_about: W6 of .build/analysis/seat-model-plan.md — HAND table of what has changed in the House since the 2025 election. build-candidate-set.mjs derives the 2025 contest set from data/aec-2025-seat-flows.json + data/seats-2025-baseline.json and merges THIS file over the top to produce data/seat-candidate-set-2028.json. Entries here are declared facts (retirements, by-elections, defections, announced independent challenges); everything not listed keeps its 2025 state under the assumptions below. Never derive entries — hand-edit as announcements land, with a date and a note naming the source. The House changes must agree with the /map/ page's own record of them (map/data/data-now.json): test-fed-model.mjs fails when the two differ.
_maintained: Human-maintained. The builder fails loudly if an entry names an unknown seat or contradicts the baseline (a retirement, by-election or defection naming someone who is not the member the 2025 election returned), so stale rows cannot drift silently. recontests on a defection: true (standing in the seat for the new party), false (not standing in the seat) or null (undecided: no sitting-member term for the new party, no defection term against the old one).

assumptions._note: 2025 base, measured in HouseDopByDivisionDownload-31496: ALP and GRN contested all 150; ON contested 147 (absent Bean/Canberra/Fenner — the ACT seats); exactly one Coalition party per seat except the seven LP+NP three-cornered contests (Barker, Bendigo, Bullwinkel, Durack, Forrest, Grey, O'Connor). ON 'everywhere' for 2028 extends past the 2025 base — those seats are flagged in the build output.

retirements.note: will not contest the next election (announced 23 October 2026: ABC News, abc.net.au/news/2026-10-23/michelle-landry-capricornia-retirement/107300492). The Nationals' leader, Senator Matt Canavan, has since announced a run for the seat; no candidate is assumed.

byElections.note: Sussan Ley resigned from Parliament on 27 February 2026; David Farley won the by-election of 9 May 2026 for One Nation (map/data/data-now.json holds the count).

independents._note: heldRecontest=true above carries the twelve member:<surname> holders. challenges[] is for declared plausible NEW independent challenges; likelihood 'declared' (candidate announced) or 'likely' (credible movement, no candidate yet).

defections.note: left the Nationals on 27 November 2025 and joined One Nation on 8 December 2025 (map/data/data-now.json). Joyce said in October 2025 that New England would not be recontested, and has since left that open (ABC News, 20 February 2026); recontests stays null until Joyce or One Nation says: the Nationals lose their sitting member either way, and no One Nation member is assumed on the ballot.
